snippet.title: 868-BACK | Official Launch Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
868-BACK is a computer-hacking strategy roguelike game where your mission is to dismantle capitalism one server at a time! Use hacking powers to fight enemies, steal the servers' data, and face increasingly nasty situations before being disconnected (again!) by the richest corporations on earth. Good luck, Hacker! You're going to need it. 

868-BACK is coming to PC & Mac on May 28th, 2026! 

👾 Wishlist 868-BACK on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3304110/868BACK/
